note: An inline script's import base is ImportBase(flow path, module id, explicit path). A deployed flow keeps the explicit path only in its failure and preprocessor slots; internal/ir decides when to pass it.

cases.title: the default import base of an inline step
cases.note: windmill-lite's import base does not depend on nesting: a step inside a for-loop has the same one (TestImportBase).

cases.title: an explicit path in a module list leaves the default base
cases.rest_in: internal/ir's WR-29/b: a deploy drops the explicit path f/elsewhere/entry of a module-list step, so the compiler gives the build the default base; the preview's "elsewhere" is out of scope (0001 §1)

given.source:
import { b } from "./x";
export function main() { return b; }

cases.title: a failure module keeps its explicit path
cases.rest_in: internal/ir's WR-29/c gives the slot its explicit path; the failure module's run in a flow is N1b's

given.source:
import { b } from "./x";
export function main() { return b; }
